g.text: Import chain (gontroller): walk -> group -> gate -> identify -> exif -> commit;
every participant is a step (own goroutine), every arrow is a typed pipe (values + the walk's flush)
identify: the item known (exiftool lives here)
exif: the EXIF perceptors, their values kept
files flow in; groups flow out one by one, steps run concurrently
Chain.Run: a pass starts the entry
first file: asset links from Photos.sqlite
(original, render, Live Photo video); buffer of open
groups, a group goes out when all its files arrived
dto.Asset (asset UUID; a file of an asset
trashed / hidden in Photos: sent as gone)
[nobody else claims it (other providers: Immich, ... later)]
sidecars by name, next to each other
(buffer: one open group; a complete group goes out)
a provider not enabled is not asked:
its files are a plain folder's
the model's Gone: a main file's item deleted,
[changed (stat, a role the grouper gave) / needs work (Rework, ...)]
ONE exiftool -j call for the group,
ExifTags + identify's own); a map per file
content sniff), rank: main file, roles
the metadata package: a tag from
what the browser shows now, no transcode:
Show / the main file (JPEG, PNG, ...; H.264 video) /
the biggest viewable derivative / the embedded one;
+ date, size, length (written into the item)
a row in every import perceptor's storage
items at once. Ready comes later from
[every row the walk did not stamp that it says is gone (V2: a complete walk,
under the root, not under unreadable directories)]
which passes it through (or makes something of it)
flush (an incomplete group waits for the next walk)
once every grouper has flushed (the chain's barrier)
the flush goes on, through every step, to the end
keep: on the flush, the perceptors' rows
of gone items pruned (the previous walk's)
Chain.Run returns: the flush reached the chain's end (commit):
every group of the walk went through every step
rescan pause (1 min), then the next pass
One asset again (Apple Photos on demand)

the item back); the next pass processes it (NeedsWork)
no waiting: the client guesses meanwhile
